purpose: Show one truthful decision signal with structured comparison, progress, chart, action, and footer slots.
accessibility: Associates the metric label and value through dt and dd semantics.
Give every chart a concise accessible label and every icon-only action its own name.
Do not rely on trend colour alone; TrendIndicator exposes direction text to assistive technology.
responsive: Value and trend wrap without clipping while bottom and inline charts retain bounded geometry.
Chart height, padding, direct icon sizing, and trend geometry follow density-aware KPI tokens.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: description
api.description: Supporting context announced with the primary content.

api.name: trend
api.description: Dedicated directional comparison slot, normally a TrendIndicator.

api.name: chart
api.description: Compact historical cue, normally a Sparkline.

api.name: chartPlacement
api.description: Places the chart at the card base or beside the value and supporting context.

api.name: progress
api.description: Goal or capacity cue, normally the canonical Progress component.

api.name: action
api.description: Optional action aligned with the metric label and icon.

api.name: footer
api.description: Separated supporting detail or link below the metric anatomy.

api.name: change
api.description: Backwards-compatible comparison slot; prefer trend for new work.

api.name: emphasis
api.description: Applies the shared bounded surface treatment to this metric.

api.name: tone
api.description: Selects the semantic colour when emphasis is explicit.

api.name: colorway
api.description: Selects a categorical series for soft, expressive or solid emphasis. Solid uses a centrally paired foreground; tone retains semantic meaning.
